x41c47a7e44.title: Ragel w Set Setat 6
x41c47a7e44.description: In the wake of Ramzy's departure, Adel starts a new chapter in his life by leaving the bazaar and opening a fool and falafel restaurant, all in the hope of improving his financial situation and getting control of his life, which he shares with six women.

x713f9823d3.title: Al Dow El Shared
x713f9823d3.description: The story chronicles the class struggle between the old feudal class represented by the Azizi family and the new owners class represented by the Sawalmi family, former wage earners who used to work for the Azizis. The Sawalmi family resorts to illegitimate ways to get money to compete with the Azizis.

xbcd88c6efb.title: Captain Azouz
xbcd88c6efb.description: The events revolve around the young sea captain, Azouz, whose father leaves him and his aunt a ship called the Shamandora to live in, along with a sailor and an assistant. As they go on different trips, they encounter funny situations and hilarious adventures.

tv228021.title: عابد كرمان
tv228021.description: يتعاون عبدالرحيم قرمان مع جهاز المخابرات المصرية كعميل داخل إسرائيل لمدة 3 سنوات. وتدور أحداث المسلسل فى وقت حرب الاستنزاف، حيث تمكن العميل المصرى من تكوين علاقة صداقة مع وزير الدفاع الإسرائيلي موشي دايان.

tv102381.title: ليالينا
tv102381.description: يعود هشام من العمل في الخليج وتتغير حياته بعد حادث سيارة تتعرض له ابنته جميلة مع السائق راضي، ويبدأ في ملاحظة ما لا يعلمه عن زوجته مريم.
tv102381.description_en: The events take place in the 1980s, revolving around the life of Hisham. As he returns from the Gulf where he has been working, his life takes a turn when his daughter Gamila gets in an accident with the driver Rady. Gradually, Hisham begins to uncover secrets about his wife, Mariam
tv102381.description_fr: La série tourne des années 1950 aux années 1980, quand une grande lutte a lieu entre deux familles et que les événements s'intensifient.

mv627203.title: الملعب
mv627203.description_en: The film depicts children trying to create space for them in a city that lacks space for fun, creating their own playground on the streets.

x2cb11de4c6.title: التاسعة
x2cb11de4c6.description: كل أخبار اليوم ينقلها مراسلو سكاي نيوز عربية في أنحاء العالم العربي وحول العالم.

mv1201732.title: الخميس
mv1201732.description: في إطار كوميدي خيالي، تدور الأحداث حول فتاة شهيرة على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، تتعرض هي ووالدها للعديد من المواقف الطريفة بسبب قصر مهجور به لعنة تصيب كل من بداخله.
mv1201732.description_en: A couple buys a new palace, but they discover that they have been deceived, and the palace has been sold to multiple people. To make matters worse, the palace is haunted and anyone who lives in it is afflicted by a magical curse!

mv1125257.title: الجمعة
mv1125257.title_fr: Freaky Friday 2 : Encore dans la peau de ma mère
mv1125257.description: في الجزء الجديد من الفيلم المنتج عام 2003، تكتشف "تيس" و"آنا كولمان" أن المفاجآت قد تحدث مرتين.
mv1125257.description_en: Years after Tess and Anna endured an identity crisis, Anna now has a daughter of her own and a soon-to-be stepdaughter. As they navigate the myriad challenges that come when two families merge, Tess and Anna discover lightning might indeed strike twice.
mv1125257.description_fr: L’histoire se déroule bien des années après la crise d’identité à laquelle les Coleman ont été confrontées. Anna est devenue mère à son tour. Elle a une fille et s’apprête à avoir une belle-fille également. Mais alors qu'elles font face à la myriade de défis que représente l’union de deux familles, Tess et Anna découvrent que, contre toute attente, la foudre peut vraiment frapper deux fois au même endroit...
